notes: An overlay over the built-in research workflow and the graphs it resolves to, written out by hand. The overlay tunes solution-generation to optional, adds deep-review after completion, and carries a lean profile that disables the node it just added; the two operations it does not use are unavailable on this graph rather than omitted by choice, and the overlay says which and why. research-tuned.eject.yml is the ten-node no-profile resolution and research-tuned.lean.yml the nine-node resolution under --profile=lean: the lean case needs an eject of its own because a definition carries no profiles, the resolver reading them from overlays only. The hash equality between each eject and the corresponding overlay route is the assertion; it is possible at all because graph_hash covers the resolved node set and excludes source, overlays, profile and name. The two .md files are the prose companions the ejects' direct: nodes resolve against, carried here because a companion is looked for beside the file that declares the node; they are stubs and the real node prose ships beside the built-in. Expectations beyond the files live in the test source: the manifest expect object is closed and widening it would be a contract-bearing change.
